title: Never played before? Start here.
sub: Padel is easy to pick up — most people are rallying within their first session. You don't need experience, and you don't need your own equipment.

items.a: A doubles racket sport played on a court about a third the size of a tennis court, surrounded by glass walls. The ball can bounce off the walls, which keeps rallies going and makes it easy to learn.
None at all. Our beginner sessions start from how to hold the racket, and a coach is on court with you the whole time.

items.q: What do I need to bring?
items.a: Just comfortable sportswear, trainers and a bottle of water. We have everything else here.
Yes. Rackets are £4 per session from reception, and they are free in beginner sessions. Balls are always included.
Anything you can move in. Flat-soled trainers work best on the court; please avoid running shoes with a heavy tread.
Choose a time on Playtomic and pay online. You will get a confirmation straight away, and you can cancel for free up to 24 hours before.
